models.subject: a medieval sword with a long straight blade and a crossguard
models.prompt: A medieval sword with a long straight blade and a crossguard, upright, complete object visible, centered, isolated on a plain gray background. Matte light gray clay sculpture, three-quarter product view, simple soft lighting.
models.label: 画像経由: 剣・初回
models.sourceMethod: SDXL Turbo 4-step text-to-image -> U2NETP foreground removal -> TripoSR 128-grid image-to-3D

models.observedLimitations: 画像の先端が切れ、背景除去で刃先を欠損。短い刃として復元。
